drug_authority.quote: A licensed physician may prescribe and order a non-patient specific regimen to a registered professional nurse, pursuant to regulations promulgated by the commissioner

license_status_types.quote: The licensure status of such licensee shall be "inactive" and he or she shall not be authorized to practice the profession

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: A foreign physician seeking a limited permit must hold a standard certificate from the Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) or pass an examination satisfactory to the state board for medicine. A U.S. resident who attended a foreign medical school recognized by WHO may qualify for full licensure by completing specified academic and clinical training, passing the required exam, and completing postgraduate hospital training.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: A foreign physician who holds a standard certificate from the educational council for foreign medical graduates or who has passed an examination satisfactory to the state board for medicine and in accordance with the commissioner's regulations

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: There shall be appointed within the department, by the board of regents, a committee on drug and alcohol abuse, which shall advise the board of regents on matters relating to practice by professional licensees with drug or alcohol abuse problems
